Pocket TTS for the browser: the tts-wasm crate of https://github.com/idle-intelligence/tts-web
(MIT, see LICENSE), commit 4ac4680af1dbe02dfbc78bf85f51e8523d614caf, built with Rust 1.99.0 and
  wasm-pack build crates/tts-wasm --target web --release --no-opt
(source paths remapped). Runs Kyutai's Pocket TTS (CC-BY-4.0) on Candle (Apache-2.0/MIT).
The model weights and voices are not here: the browser loads them from Hugging Face.
